About the Artist

I'm Monika, a pianist who tells stories through keys.

The piano found me before I could read words — and it never let go. Trained in the classical tradition and shaped by years of conservatory study, I perform the repertoire I love with the honesty it deserves: Chopin's nocturnes at midnight, Beethoven's thunder, Debussy's pastel light.

For me, a recital is a conversation. I want every listener to leave the hall feeling something they didn't have a name for before the first note.

Moments between notes

The Journey

An artistic odyssey

2018

First Full-Length Recital

Performed her first solo recital — an all-Chopin programme in a candlelit hall that left the audience in silence before the applause.

2021

Conservatory Studies

Deepened her classical training with advanced study in interpretation, chamber music and the great Romantic concertos.

2024

International Performances

Invited to perform across Europe and Asia — from Viennese salons to festival stages — earning recognition for her luminous tone.

2025

Debut Recording

Entered the studio to record her first album — a nocturne collection recorded in the quiet hours she loves most.

Monika doesn't play the piano — she speaks through it. In her hands, Chopin becomes a confession and Beethoven becomes weather.
